title: Our Tour Starts the Night Before You Do
why: First-timers worried about safety and logistics: the real pre-tour checklist our guides run, which builds trust without saying "safe" ten times.
hook_options: Our tour starts the night before you do.
The checklist your guide runs before you arrive.
What happens before anyone touches a paddle.
caption: Before you ever see a kayak, your guide has already texted you, read the manifest, checked weather and water, inspected the van and counted every life jacket. This is the actual checklist. You just paddle. #SwampTour #NewOrleans #KayakTour #BehindTheScenes

slides.headline: Our tour starts the night before you do.
slides.body: What your guide checks before anyone touches a paddle. This is the actual checklist.

slides.headline: Every guest gets a text.
slides.body: Pickup time, what to wear, and a real number to reach. Then the guide pulls up the manifest.

slides.headline: Special notes get read first.
slides.body: Nervous paddler, birthday, bad knee. It's on the booking for a reason, and the guide checks it before the trip.

slides.headline: Weather and water get checked.
slides.body: Lightning cancels. Light rain doesn't. High water can change the route, and the guide decides before launch.

slides.headline: Tires, fuel, a clean interior.
slides.body: It gets a once-over before pickup. Our logs even note the fuel level when it comes back.

slides.headline: Every life jacket. Every paddle.
slides.body: Counted, checked for damage, fitted to you on shore. Plus a guide bag with first aid and spare water.

slides.headline: The briefing covers four things.
slides.body: Paddle technique, life jacket fit, what to do if you flip, and group signals. Ask anything here.

slides.headline: Your guide counts heads. A lot.
slides.body: The log records how many launched and how many came back. Those two numbers have to match.

slides.headline: Gear cleaned. Log written. Van fueled.
slides.body: Every trip gets a written log. It's how we know which bayous are open this week.

slides.headline: You paddle. We sweat the list.
slides.body: Small-group kayak swamp tours from New Orleans. Share it with the planner in your group.
